column1: # The Rust API's access windows on a tabulated ephemeris (spacelab::access::tabulated_windows), to the bit (Ф31.C).
# Written by crates/spacelab/tests/bridge_access_tabulated.rs; the C ABI and the Python bridge must reproduce it. A double is the 16 hex digits of its bits.
# The LAGEOS-1 samples are the ILRS combination in tests/fixtures/ilrsa_lageos1_20250106.sp3: ILRS data, cited as Pearlman et al. (2019), doi:10.1007/s00190-019-01241-1.
